Investigative journalist and bestselling author Andy Ngo joins Libby Emmons on The Pod Millennial to uncover the disturbing story of the Zizians, a secretive extremist group linked to multiple deaths and criminal investigations across the United States.

Discussing his new book, The Zizians: Inside a Trans Death Cult, Ngo traces the group's origins in Silicon Valley's rationalist and effective altruist communities, its radical beliefs about artificial intelligence and animal rights, and the alleged violence surrounding its members. From mysterious identities and unconventional living arrangements to the killing of a U.S. Border Patrol agent and other criminal cases, Ngo takes us inside one of the country's most unsettling true-crime stories.
